_comment: Plugin hook registration for sage-gate1-pre-decision. Auto-discovered at the plugin root (hooks/hooks.json) on install — no manifest 'hooks' field needed. Same shape as a settings.json 'hooks' block. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (the plugin's install dir) in EXEC form (command:'node' + args:[path]) so the path is passed as one argument with no quoting (plugins-reference: 'In hook commands, use exec form with args'). 'timeout' is SECONDS; the hooks self-abort at 28000ms (< 30s) and return their honest result first. UserPromptSubmit frames the top-level task (and can block in strict mode). PreToolUse matched to the subagent-spawn tool (Task|Agent) frames each delegated subagent's task (tool_input.prompt) and can block too. The credential is read from the env var SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL (set in your settings 'env' block) — it is NEVER bundled in the plugin. Endpoint/depth/fail-mode default to local; override via GATE1_ENDPOINT / GATE1_DEPTH / GATE1_FAIL_MODE env or a gate1.config.json. See ../README.md.
